facts.fact: Le Sahel (ONEP) reports that the second component of the France-Spain-Niger joint investigation team project is to create a procedure-drafting software, LRP, for the DST's special investigations division, to help Nigerien police officers draft their procès-verbaux; it is announced as planned, not as in use.
Le Sahel (ONEP) describes the LRP procedure-drafting software as a future creation for the DST's special investigations division only; no station, commissariat or post is said to use it.

Le Sahel (ONEP) reports that the joint investigation team project, whose second component is the LRP software, is financed by the European Union through France and Spain, which gave equipment worth EUR 156,000 (FCFA 102 million) under its first component.
